problem: Section 3 sets a rule that a film controls only when its share is above about 80%. Quiz Q4 then says the liquid film 'now controls' when its share is 65.2%, which contradicts the rule the student was just given.
fix: State the rule as: the film with the larger share carries the larger resistance and therefore controls; when one share is above about 80% the other film can be neglected in design calculations. Then in Q4 answer: 'Liquid-film share = 37.5/57.5 = 65.2%, now the larger resistance, so the liquid film controls (the gas film is no longer negligible).'
